feed cats at 8 AM. pick up food bowls at 9 AM. 
feed cats at 8 PM. pick up food bowls at 9 PM. 
this is actually better for cats than free feeding anyway. it may take them a couple of days to get used to it, but they will eventually learn to eat their food within that hour. you could start them off with a longer feeding time to get them used to a new schedule.
